description: Source code for a Mattermost webhook test server using Express.js, handling various webhook endpoints, OAuth flows, dialog interactions, and message responses.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning server status and available endpoints.

methods.name: doSetup
methods.description: Sets base URLs and admin credentials from request body.

methods.name: postSendOauthCredentials
methods.description: Initializes OAuth client with provided app ID and secret.

methods.name: getStartOAuth
methods.description: Redirects to OAuth authorization URI.

methods.name: getCompleteOauth
methods.description: Completes OAuth flow and stores authenticated user.

methods.name: postOAuthMessage
methods.description: Posts a message to a channel using OAuth token.

methods.name: postSlackCompatibleMessageResponse
methods.description: Returns a JSON response formatted for Slack compatibility.

methods.name: postMessageMenus
methods.description: Handles message menu interactions and returns ephemeral text.

methods.name: openDialog
methods.description: Helper to open dialogs via API call.

methods.name: onDialogRequest
methods.description: Handles dialog request, opens full dialog.

methods.name: onSimpleDialogRequest
methods.description: Handles simple dialog request, opens dialog.

methods.name: onUserAndChannelDialogRequest
methods.description: Handles user and channel dialog request.

methods.name: onBooleanDialogRequest
methods.description: Handles boolean dialog request.

methods.name: onMultiSelectDialogRequest
methods.description: Handles multiselect dialog request.

methods.name: onDynamicSelectDialogRequest
methods.description: Handles dynamic select dialog request.

methods.name: onDynamicSelectSource
methods.description: Provides dynamic options for select based on search query.

methods.name: onDateTimeDialogRequest
methods.description: Handles datetime dialog request, opens dialog based on command.

methods.name: onDateTimeDialogSubmit
methods.description: Processes datetime dialog submission, logs values, and responds.

methods.name: onDialogSubmit
methods.description: Handles dialog submission, including multistep and field refresh.

methods.name: postSendMessageToChannel
methods.description: Sends a message to specified channel with optional type.

methods.name: sendSysadminResponse
methods.description: Sends a message as sysadmin user.

methods.name: getWebhookResponse
methods.description: Generates payload string for outgoing webhook response.

methods.name: postOutgoingWebhook
methods.description: Responds to outgoing webhook with optional overrides.

methods.name: onFieldRefreshDialogRequest
methods.description: Handles field refresh dialog request.

methods.name: onMultistepDialogRequest
methods.description: Handles multistep dialog request.

methods.name: onFieldRefreshSource
methods.description: Provides dynamic form elements based on project type.
